hierarchy-bundles.visual_critic_note: Clean card-based UI with intentional green palette and depth-opacity encoding, but the 900×900 SVG is clipped below the fold in the screenshot and the edge bundles collapse into an unreadable tangle at the circle-pack center.
hierarchy-bundles.encoding_integrity_note: Structurally honest — scaleSqrt correctly used for force-layout node sizing, key functions present on both node and link joins, data-driven radiusScale domain; minor issue: sunburst applies a redundant scaleSqrt to the radial (depth) axis, which compresses outer rings without a clear magnitude justification.
hierarchy-bundles.stress_test_note: The tension slider and easing-param sliders fire un-throttled redraws/full transitions on every `input` event with no RAF coalescing or debounce, and no `.interrupt()` is called before new layout transitions begin, allowing mid-flight conflicts when buttons are clicked during a 1500ms animation.
hierarchy-bundles.cognitive_load_note: The circle-pack hierarchy is legible and color groups are distinguishable, but 300 near-straight edges (tension at 8%) converge into a dense hairball at the center that overwhelms the structure they're meant to reveal; interaction-based highlighting rescues it, but the at-rest view is cluttered.
